reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual fourth-round review of external-04 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 06 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-04 now has exactly two upper note rows with exactly two compact gray-mark groups in each row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The high bald crown, short gray-brown side hair, dark eyebrows and thin rectangular spectacles remain. The face has one restrained closed mouth and no added moustache or beard. The slight viewer-left pose, red/gold collar patches, pale ribbon and one small silver-toned pendant remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Precise spectacle-rim geometry, tiny pendant/ribbon details and note glyph identity are not fully readable at source scale. These fine uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the required two groups in each of two rows are directly visible in the native return.
